93:t_1:3.en: ～ Inside $$マクロス・クォーター$$ ～

93:t_1:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'm the wandering repairman of $$ビーター・サービス$$, $$ランド・トラビス$$. My street name, $$ザ・ヒート$$, might be more famous, though.」

93:t_1:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「For you, maybe I should introduce myself as the Reactor of the $$傷だらけの獅子$$.」

93:t_1:9.en:
$$ランド$$
「I heard about it from $$アルト$$ and the others. So you're the Reactor of the $$いがみ合う双子$$, huh.」

93:t_1:11.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well... we're fellow Reactors. Though I kind of knew the moment we met.」

93:t_1:13.en:
$$ランド$$
「Looks like getting beaten by $$バルビエル$$ was a real shock.」

93:t_1:15.en:
$n
「...How can I draw out the power of the $$スフィア$$...?」

93:t_1:17.en:
$n
「If I could do that, even against that $$バルビエル$$...」

93:t_1:20.en:
$$ランド$$
「Nothing good comes of being jerked around by a $$スフィア$$. If you want to take down $$バルビエル$$, find another way.」

93:t_1:22.en:
$$ランド$$
「Just get stronger than that guy, that's all.」

93:t_1:24.en:
$$ランド$$
「Finally got some strength in those eyes. Now we can have a proper talk.」

93:t_1:25.en:
$$ランド$$
「I was thinking that if the guy $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ had his eye on kept sulking forever, I'd have to fire him up the hard way, but...」

93:t_1:27.en:
$$ランド$$
「Yeah... I traveled with him until not long ago.」

93:t_1:28.en:
$$ランド$$
「He told me, you know. That you'd be the one to save us.」

93:t_1:30.en:
$n
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$ risked his life to save me. I want to live up to that.」

93:t_1:31.en:
$n
「No... not just $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. I want to fight for all the people who lent me strength to live.」

93:t_1:32.en:
$$ランド$$
「To repay a debt of gratitude, huh... Not bad.」

93:t_1:33.en:
$$ランド$$
「Then I'll lend you my strength too.」

93:t_1:35.en:
$$ランド$$
「Whoa, don't expect too much. Even if I lend you a hand, all I can do is repairs and drinking.」

93:t_1:38.en:
$$ランド$$
「Then I'll pass on what the person who looked after me taught me back when I was your age.」

93:t_1:42.en:
$$ランド$$
「What I'm going to teach you is the smile. Smile.」

93:t_1:43.en:
$n
「You can't just say that to me...」

93:t_1:44.en:
$$ランド$$
「I don't know what happened to you, and I can't fix that for you either. So I'll teach you the strength to live from here on.」

93:t_1:47.en:
$$ランド$$
「From deeper in your heart. Smile even when you're sad or in pain. The feelings follow later.」

93:t_1:48.en:
$$ランド$$
「Flip everything on its head! Then you can face forward and keep going!」

93:t_1:51.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's do this, $n. If you're going to save me, then I'll save you too.」

93:t_1:57.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...Let me start with the conclusion.」

93:t_1:59.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Just as I thought, you don't have any $$トップレス$$ in you.」

93:t_1:61.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Well, of course not. You're an android, after all.」

93:t_1:62.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Still, you can't tell at all just by looking. Even the skin is no different from a normal girl's.」

93:t_1:65.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Well... because you're the champion of justice who protects everyone. Seeing the ace of this $$フラタニティ$$ take down $$宇宙怪獣$$ makes $$ノノ$$'s heart go pitter-patter!」

93:t_1:66.en:
$$チコ$$
「Though that ace spot is going to be mine soon.」

93:t_1:67.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Oh! You're feeling bold now that you're the pilot of $$キャトフヴァンディス$$, $$チコ$$!」

93:t_1:68.en:
$$チコ$$
「Honestly... why did I have to compete with a girl like this for the pilot seat of $$キャトフヴァンディス$$...」

93:t_1:69.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's because $$ノノ$$'s hard work and guts were recognized...」

93:t_1:70.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「No... it just looked like fun.」

93:t_1:72.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Because $$ディスヌフ$$ put out more power than ever to save you.」

93:t_1:73.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I thought you might have something special that attracts $$バスターマシン$$s.」

93:t_1:76.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Like I said~, that's impossible! You're an android!」

93:t_1:77.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I wouldn't say that, $$カシオ$$.」

93:t_1:78.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「$$トップレス$$ is the expression of advanced spirituality. It has been pointed out that any AI with a self and intelligence could have the potential to be $$トップレス$$.」

93:t_1:79.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「There just haven't been any actual examples.」

93:t_1:80.en:
$$チコ$$
「Are you saying that example is this girl?」

93:t_1:82.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Thank you, $$ニコラ$$! With hard work and guts, $$ノノ$$ will do her best as a member of this 《$$フラタニティ$$》!」

93:t_1:83.en:
$$ラルク$$
「For now I've allowed you to hang around here, but $$ノノ$$'s job is to support us as a Machine Weapon.」

93:t_1:84.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm still happy! Because I get to fight alongside Big Sis!」

ザ・ヒート.evidence: Rand's self-styled street name (work/tengoku/library_briefs/pt_454.md: 「ザ・ヒート」を自称する...); not in sheet
